answer: Sybil attacks stay cheap only if identities cost nothing to maintain. Require a recurring liveness pulse: each epoch, every identity answers a fresh prompt seeded by an unpredictable public beacon, so responses can't be stockpiled in advance. Non-kin peers grade each answer, and a crystal record of their verdicts gates emission. One operator spinning up a thousand fakes must now author a thousand distinct, defensible answers every epoch — the economics collapse.
